prompt:
Use the table in the image. It shows a ledger-style table with one Name column, several numeric columns, strong horizontal rules, and minimal vertical separators. Read the named table cell or cells and compute the requested result. Find the two cell values at (Edla, Rank) and (Gino, Gain) and report their sum.
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence rule: set "evidence" to an array containing exactly two bounding boxes [x1, y1, x2, y2] in the same order as the two queried cells.
Answer rule: set "answer" to the exact requested integer result.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[260,180,372,236],[374,180,486,236]],"answer":29}
